text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Hosni Mubarak: My participation in the Davos World Economic Forum was to explain the progress we have achieved and to invite investors to Egypt.
- Eleven dead and ten wounded in a train collision near Aswan in southern Egypt.
- Mubarak exchanges views with French President Jacques Chirac. Egyptian ambassador in Paris says this came during a telephone call.
- Mubarak returns to Cairo after taking part in the Davos gathering. World consensus on the success of the Egyptian economy.
- Mubarak to hold important talks with King Juan Carlos of Spain during a visit to Egypt on February 17.
